decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The timber door, beam and side post hereby permitted shall be installed not later than 3 months from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - 9.2	The application for the removal of uPVC porch, and installation of timber door, beam and side post, as shown on drawing numbers WD-01, received 10th January 2006, is recommended for approval as the proposed development would relate well to the existing streetscene and original dwelling, and is considered to preserve and enhance the appearance and character of Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Removal of uPVC porch, and installation of timber door, beam and side post.
